_comment: News source registry for the §3.11 editorial-news module. Each source is fetched by news_collector.py, classified by news_classifier.py, and stored via POST /api/admin/news. Legal rule (see NEWS_MODULE.md): we store headline + our own LLM summary + link + source + timestamp only, NEVER the source's full article body. 'coverage_weight' feeds the source-weighted tone aggregation required by TZ §3.3.

_legend.type: rss | openinfo | html | telegram — the fetcher to use
_legend.content: full = feed ships whole article (we still store snippet only); snippet = title+summary+link; none = no feed, scrape sitemap
_legend.legal: safe = reuse with attribution/link-back OK; caution = snippet+link only, respect crawl rules; avoid_fulltext = ToS bars reproduction, headline+link only
_legend.coverage_weight: 0..1 relative audience/authority weight for tone aggregation
_legend.crawl_delay_s: minimum seconds between requests to this host

sources.name: openinfo.uz — material facts
sources.notes: Primary issuer channel: dividends (fact 42), issuance (25), large/affiliate transactions, ownership >10%/20%, management changes. Reuse permitted with link-back. Already reachable from the collector host.

sources.name: Central Bank of Uzbekistan
sources.notes: Policy-rate decisions and FX policy. Official full-text RSS, ttl 60.

sources.name: Republican Stock Exchange Toshkent (UZSE)
sources.notes: Exchange news: listings, suspensions, new members. robots.txt bans AI-labelled UAs (GPTBot etc.) and requires a 60s crawl-delay; send a browser-style UA, never an AI-labelled one.

sources.name: Kursiv Media Uzbekistan
sources.notes: Business/finance specialist, hourly. Best signal-to-noise for markets. Feed ships full text; store snippet only.

sources.name: Spot.uz
sources.notes: OOO Afisha Media, registered e-media #1207 (2019). Business focus. Deferred: enable as a second business feed after MVP proves out.

sources.name: Kun.uz
sources.notes: Largest general-news audience. Feed is at /ru/news/rss (NOT /rss, which 404s). Deferred (high volume, general news — lots to filter).

sources.name: UzDaily.uz
sources.notes: Business daily; English mirror of financial news. Deferred.

sources.name: Review.uz
sources.notes: Analytical journal, carries CERR pieces. Deferred.

sources.name: UzA — National News Agency
sources.notes: State news agency — authoritative for decrees. Deferred.

sources.name: Gazeta.uz
sources.notes: Major outlet. ToS: 'Materials may not be reproduced or distributed without prior written permission.' Headline + link + attribution ONLY, never store any article text. Deferred.

sources.name: Daryo.uz
sources.notes: No RSS; permissive robots (only /preview/ blocked). Needs an HTML scraper. Deferred.

sources.name: КорпИнфо (Telegram)
sources.notes: ~8.3K subs, Uzbekistan capital-market wire. Read-only via public web mirror t.me/s/. Treat as a LEAD source: confirm against an openinfo fact or outlet feed before showing to users. Deferred.
